items.exampleEn: We are having a birthday party tonight.
items.exampleZh: 我們今晚要開生日派對。

items.exampleEn: Their son is five years old.
I want to learn about Japanese culture.
My brother is two years older than me.

items.sentenceEn: My wife and I love our baby.
items.sentenceZh: 我太太和我很愛我們的寶寶。

items.audioEn: Tonight is my son's birthday party. He is six.
items.audioZh: 今晚是我兒子的生日派對，他六歲。

items.sentenceZh: 她爸媽很喜歡韓國文化。

items.stemEn: This is Mr. Lin and his ____, Mrs. Lin.
items.stemZh: 這位是林先生和他的太太林太太。

items.stemEn: We are having a ____ for her birthday.
items.stemZh: 我們要為她辦生日派對。

items.passageEn: Mr. and Mrs. Wang have a new baby. He is their first son. Today, the family has a party at home. Mrs. Wang's brother brings a cake, and her parents bring some baby clothes. Everyone loves the baby.
items.passageZh: 王先生和王太太剛生了寶寶，是他們的第一個兒子。今天他們在家裡辦派對。王太太的兄弟帶了一個蛋糕，她的爸媽帶了一些嬰兒衣服。大家都很喜歡這個寶寶。

questions.questionZh: 王家的寶寶是男生還是女生？
王太太的兄弟帶了什麼？

rubricZh: love 後面直接接人（例如 love my parents）
「爸媽」可寫 parents，或 my mom and dad、my father and mother 等

referenceEn: My little brother likes to play soccer.
My younger brother likes playing soccer.
rubricZh: 「弟弟」可寫，例如 little brother、younger brother、brother 等
「踢足球」可寫，例如 play soccer、play football 等；like 後面接 to＋原形、動名詞都正確
